policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: current visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current Russian MFA passport-type table expressly records visa-free ordinary Russian-passport travel for Grenada, Jordan and Trinidad and Tobago.
conditions: Grenada is up to 90 days in 180 days; Jordan is up to 30 days per visit and 90 days in a calendar year; Trinidad and Tobago is up to 90 days.
This records ordinary short-visitor treatment only and excludes work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions.
